description: Record of one advisor panel (orch.advisor.panel) on a problem: the independent advice of each member that answered, and the synthesis the conductor reads: agreement, a majority confirmed or not by one critic, or a split. The synthesis carries the closed advice the gates read.

members.description: The members that answered, in panel order; at least two.

items.description: One member and its independent advice.

file.description: Repository path of the advice file of the member.

member.description: Place of the member in orch.advisor.panel, from 1.

problem_ref.description: The problem advised on, as the prompt named it.

advice.description: The one closed advice the conductor reads (human gate, minimum confidence, code categories).

critic.description: The one round of critique of a majority: a member of the minority read the anonymised positions.

agrees.description: Whether the critic recommended the option of the majority and cited evidence; otherwise the owner decides.

file.description: Repository path of the advice file of the critic.

member.description: Place of the critic in orch.advisor.panel, from 1.

recommendation.description: Option the critic recommended; null when the critic gave no advice.

kind.description: agreement (all recommend one option), majority (more than half) or split.

trigger.description: The single advice whose low confidence started the panel (trigger low_confidence).

file.description: Repository path of that advice file.

title: advice panel
